name: MailerSend
description:
The MailerSend connector lets Claude work directly with your MailerSend account so you can handle transactional email without leaving the conversation.

Send email: Compose and send transactional emails — including HTML, plain text, CC/BCC, attachments, and template-based messages. Schedule messages for later, and list, inspect, or cancel scheduled sends.
 
Domains: Add and configure sending domains, retrieve DNS records, trigger and check domain verification, and update domain settings.
Templates: Browse, inspect, and delete email templates in your account.
Analytics & activity: Pull delivery and engagement analytics broken down by date, country, and recipient client (user agent name and type). Review message history and recipient activity such as opens, clicks, bounces, and complaints.
Email verification: Verify individual email addresses (synchronously or asynchronously) and run bulk verification lists to keep your sending lists clean.
Webhooks: Create, list, inspect, update, and delete webhooks to wire MailerSend events into your own systems.

Access is scoped to your own MailerSend account through a secure OAuth sign-in — the connector never sees or stores your API key. Just connect, authorize, and start managing your email in natural language.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MailerSend to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MailerSend to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mailersend.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MailerSend MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MailerSend lists 38 MCP tools, including add_domain, create_verification_list, create_webhook, delete_domain, delete_scheduled_message, delete_template, delete_webhook, fetch, get_activity, get_analytics_by_country, get_analytics_by_date, and get_analytics_by_user_agent_name.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MailerSend?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MailerSend in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
MailerSend requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MailerSend is developed by MailerSend. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
